description_en: User creates a custom check item
description_zh: 在云安全态势管理自定义检查项功能中，更新用户自定义检查项
name: UpdateCheckItem

parameters.help_en: Array of section IDs associated with the check item
parameters.help_zh: 检查项关联的章节ID数组
parameters.name: section_ids

parameters.help_en:
Cloud asset vendor.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) API to get the available vendors
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取可填入的厂商
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
Asset type of the cloud product.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) API to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的资产类型。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Sub-asset type of the cloud product.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) API to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的资产子类型。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_sub_type

parameters.help_en: Name of the custom check item
parameters.name: check_show_name

parameters.help_en:
Risk level of the check item. Values:
HIGH: High risk
MEDIUM: Medium risk
LOW: Low risk
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的风险等级。取值：
HIGH：高危
MEDIUM：中危
LOW：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
Status of the check item. Values:
EDIT: In editing
RELEASE: Released

Changing from Released to In editing will clear all historical records
Only the Released status allows the use of the check item for inspection
parameters.help_zh:
检查项状态。取值：
EDIT：编辑中
RELEASE：已发布

从已发布改为编辑中会清除所有历史记录
只有已发布状态才能使用检查项检查
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
Type of the check item description. Values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项描述信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
Type of the help information for the check item risk. Values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项风险的帮助信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Content of the help information for the check item risk
fields.help_zh: 检查项风险的帮助信息的内容
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Help information for the check item
parameters.name: assist_info

fields.help_en:
Type of the solution information for the check item. Values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项解决方案信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Content of the solution for the check item risk
fields.help_zh: 检查项风险的解决方案内容
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Solution information for the check item
parameters.name: solution

parameters.help_en: Definition rule for the custom check item
parameters.help_zh: 自定义检查项定义规则
parameters.name: check_rule

parameters.help_en:
ID of the custom check item to be updated.
You can call the [ListCheckItems](~~ListCheckItems~~) API to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
待更新的自定义检查项ID。
您可调用[ListCheckItems](~~ListCheckItems~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: check_id

schema.description_en: Data body returned by the interface

CheckId.description_en: ID of the updated check item

RequestId.description_en: ID of the current request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request and can be used for troubleshooting and problem localization
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
